verdict.rationale: WezTerm's own repository describes it as a GPU-accelerated terminal, and one user finds it fast. Another notes its lower OpenGL/GLES requirements. Hands-on reports are mixed: one user saw latency noticeably higher than Kitty plus blank-painted lines in vim on macOS (fine on Linux), and another found input latency above cmd.exe on Windows. None of this directly tests heavy-output throughput. Missing for 10: first-party docs on the GPU rendering pipeline and performance, evidence of responsiveness under heavy output, consistent cross-platform latency.
